data.rules:
LGN/STN OF MM1-MM3 THROUGH THE BLOCKFACE ROUTE (SUN 15 NOV 2026)
Rules written 14:36 (by `date`), before any number of this test. The question is the author's: does the sharper
blockface template give better registrations along the chain? CPU only. New names only. Nothing of record is touched.

What is compared
  Today the paper's LGN/STN (and tracers) go through the MRI route, which never touches the blockface template:
    bf-native -> b0-native (R1) -> MRI template (R5)
  (record: paper/numbers/lgnstn_geometry_current_h9.json; between-brain median centroid distance LGN 0.494, STN 0.4845 mm).
  This test carries the same labels through the BLOCKFACE route instead, to the same MRI template grid, and computes the same
  measures:
    R9 (with step 9):  MRI-template point y -> d2bs8_s5sym pull map bftemplate__to__mri-template -> blockface-template point x
                       -> x + U(x) (step-9 field, 0.15 mm grid, trilinear, border values) -> step-8 member warp (d2bs8_bfview
                       nln_step_08/iteration_03 <S>_scalar_mod_01_to_template_warp_resampled_unbiased_full, fsl_rel, src grid canon
                       t1_grey) -> hr.native_map(S) (run-113 -> native blockface world, the brain's registration of record)
                       -> the label in native blockface space.
                       This is hr.member_job's chain, the one every step-9 input was carried through.
    R8 (step 8 only):  the same chain with U = 0. It shows what the step-9 template adds on its own.
  U per brain:
    MM2 = MR252 and MM3 = MR256 are in S12. Their photographs BUILT the template's image, and U is their u_3, the composed
      iteration-3 field of the template's construction (out_015 iteration_03/fields/<S>_u.npy, 0.15 mm).
    MM1 = MR243 is NOT in S12. It did not build the image. U is today's outside registration to the finished template
      (out_015/outside9/fields/MR243.npy, TESTS.md addendum 14).
  All three were in the 21-brain step-8 (MMORF) build, as were all 21 brains. Every route therefore shares their step-8 alignment.

Labels
  Primary: the paper's inputs, labels/push_current_h9/<S>/<S>_<struct>_bfnative_L2_demons.nii.gz (H9, no MR252 frame-36 refit).
  These are the same files the MRI route of record started from, so the comparison differs only in the route.
  Secondary: the data tree's composites, labels/h9_2026-11-12/lgnstn_composites_h9/sub-<S>/<S>_lgn_stn_blockface.nii.gz.
    - Key 1 lhLGN, 2 rhLGN, 3 lhSTN, 4 rhSTN. MR252 carries the 9 Nov frame-36 refit.
    - Compared with the composites' own MRI-route files (<S>_lgn_stn_template.nii.gz; the "H9 + refit" row: LGN 0.49, STN 0.50).

Carry rule: labels_to_template.py --dense, unchanged
  - Crop to the label's bounding box + 2 mm (at least 1 mm along the section axis).
  - Gaussian anti-aliasing per source axis with FWHM = max(source spacing, 0.25 mm) (label_refs.aa_sigma).
  - ONE linear resample through the route onto template/mri/linc_mri_b0.nii.gz (0.25 mm), then > 0.5.
  - Evaluated in a box on the MRI template grid: the MRI-route label of record united with the GT label of that structure,
    dilated by 6 mm.

Measures: labels/lgnstn_geometry.py's row_metrics and stats, imported unchanged
  - Per hemisphere-structure, the 3 pairs of brains (pairwise_subjects). LGN = lhLGN + rhLGN (6 rows), STN likewise.
  - Medians of centroid distance (primary), ASSD, HD95 and Dice. subject_vs_GT is secondary.
  - Reported for R8, R9 and the MRI route side by side. No pass or fail: the comparison is reported as it comes.

Checks (stop and report if one fails)
  C1 Reproduction: the MRI route's medians, recomputed with the same functions from push_current_h9's
     *_mri-template_mask_demons, equal the record's summary medians (lgnstn_geometry_current_h9) within 6e-4.
  C2 World and chain: each brain's native L2 photograph (hr.Native: n01 / valid, valid >= 0.5), carried through R9 onto the MRI
     template grid, is correlated with T3s12_015_in_mri_grey in the template's brainmask. Pearson r is reported. r < 0.5 means
     a convention error (a wrong world gives about 0): stop.
  C3 Every carried label is non-empty and has no voxel on its box's border (no truncation).
  C4 The composites of MR243 and MR256 equal push_current_h9's bfnative_L2_demons labels voxel for voxel (composites README).
     If not, report it.

Guards (h9run-style)
  - Every write goes through one helper that refuses any path outside labels/bfroute_s9_2026-11-15/.
  - Records are read only. No paper/numbers record is written unless asked.

If the author picks option C (TESTS.md addendum 16), this reruns on S11: MR252 and MR256 are in S11 too (their S11 u_3);
MR243 uses its S11 outside field.
